title: Zeroth hypercohomology on a small ringed site
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a small site and $\mathcal O$ a sheaf of commutative rings. Write $\operatorname{Mod}(\mathcal O)$ for the category of sheaves of $\mathcal O$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and $D(\mathcal O)$ for its unbounded derived category [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. The global sections functor is $\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\mathcal O}(\mathcal O,-)$ with values in abelian groups. Define the functor $H^0(\mathcal C,-):D(\mathcal O)\to\operatorname{Ab}$ as $H^0\circ R\Gamma(\mathcal C,-)$, where $R\Gamma$ is the unbounded right derived functor computed on K-injective complexes [def-pur-kinjective-complex]. Thus for any K-injective complex $\mathcal J^\bullet$ representing $K$, $H^0(\mathcal C,K)$ is canonically isomorphic to $H^0(\Gamma(\mathcal C,\mathcal J^\bullet))$, independently of the representative. Such representatives exist by [prop-pur-kinjective-resolutions-exist].

def ringedSiteZerothHypercohomologyOfUniverses
    {C : Type c} [Category.{v} C] (J : GrothendieckTopology C)
    [HasSheafify J AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    [J.WEqualsLocallyBijective AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}]
    (R : Sheaf J CommRingCat.{max c v r})
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R))] :
    DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{max c v r}
      ((sheafCompose J
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{max c v r} RingCat.{max c v r})).obj R)) ⥤
      AddCommGrpCat.{max c v r}
lean.note: Maintenance repair for NZ/lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus: the old API equated site object, site morphism and coefficient universes and could not accept Scheme.ProEt.topology Y and its completed integral coefficient sheaf. This companion publicly imports the unchanged legacy API and uses independent site universes c, v, coefficients/modules max c v r, canonical sheafification instances and the standard derived-category localization. Mathematical statement and graph unchanged. The separate side-only module is required because the compiler uses published live artifacts for existing live modules. This is the same real construction H0 composed with the right derived functor of Hom_R(R,-); no definition data is sorry.
